style: Epic cinematic painted poster, the kind made for a film: dark and monumental, volumetric light cutting through smoke, dust, rain or embers, rich painterly realism with depth and texture, dramatic scale and atmosphere. Serious and grand, never cartoonish, never flat vector, never pop art. The players are real-looking athletes but portraits of no one: a face turned away, lost in shadow or in the glare, never a featureless blank. What makes the moment recognisable is the situation - the clock, the distance, the geometry, who stands and who falls, the object at the instant. Team colours are kept. Every figure named is present as described and nobody else. No scoreboard and no clock anywhere unless the scene names one, and then only where it says; no text of any kind; no logos, no wordmarks, no numbers, no border, no caption, no title, no credits, no watermark.

moments.title: The Bounce
moments.look: Cold moonlit silver and deep red, mist along the floor, the ball the only warm light in the frame.
moments.prompt: Seen from behind the baseline, low. A forward in a black jersey is crouched on his heels in the corner, both hands on his knees, head tilted up, frozen. Beside him a tall defender in a white jersey is still in the air, one arm up. Above them the rim, and resting on the very front of its iron, a basketball glowing like an ember at the top of its fourth bounce. The shot clock above the backboard burns 0.0 in red. Beyond, the arena is a dark red haze of a crowd holding its breath.

moments.title: From the Logo
moments.look: Vast scale and black void, the shooter small, the ball's trail the brightest thing in the frame.
moments.prompt: Seen from behind and above a lone shooter in a dark navy jersey standing at the half-court logo with both arms still raised in his follow-through, drawn small near the bottom of the frame. The whole empty half court stretches away from him into darkness toward a tiny lit rim at the far end. The ball is a burning streak of gold arcing high through the black above the floor, halfway there. Dust and light hang in the air; the crowd is a dim band at the edges. Navy and gold on black.

moments.title: The Dagger
moments.look: A blinding wall of yellow light behind, the figures dark and rim-lit, grain and haze.
moments.prompt: From floor level. A guard in a black jersey is at the top of a step-back jump shot, leaning back, the ball just off his fingertips above his head, far outside the glowing three-point arc. Right in front of him a defender in a white jersey lunges a half step too late, right arm stretched up past the ball, body twisting off balance. The ball's path is a thin red line toward a rim at the left edge. Behind them every seat in the arena is a solid wall of yellow, and a clock in the glare reads 53.0.

moments.title: The Last Shot
moments.look: Chiaroscuro: one warm spotlight from above, near-black everywhere else, dust in the beam.
moments.prompt: At the top of the key a shooter in a red jersey is frozen in a full follow-through: right arm extended toward the rim at the top right, wrist snapped down, fingers hanging, feet just landing. One stride to his left a defender in a white jersey with purple trim stumbles backward and away, off balance, his left hand reaching down for the floor, as if pushed. The ball hangs small in the beam halfway to the rim. A scoreboard glows in the dark above: 5.2. The lit floor under them is the only ground; the rest is black.

moments.title: The Shrug
moments.look: Smoke and warm rim light, a black arena.
moments.prompt: The player is a Black man in a white jersey with red trim and white shorts, jogging back up the floor toward the viewer after the sixth three, just past the broadcast table. The shrug exactly as it happened: both elbows bent and held out from his body, forearms level, both palms open and turned up at chest height, shoulders lifted, head turned to his right toward the broadcast table at the right edge of the frame, a faint perplexed half-smile, mouth slightly open, face partly lit and partly in shadow - the face of no one in particular. Nobody else on the floor. No clock, no scoreboard.
concepts: Six basketballs hang in an arc in the black above him, each burning like a small sun and trailing fire, their light falling on his shoulders through the drifting smoke.

Seen from the broadcast table's side of the floor so he looks almost toward the viewer. Behind him, drawn in thin lines of gold light across the dark arena, six arcs rise from six spots beyond the three-point line and fall into one distant rim, the paths of the six threes still hanging in the air.

A wide shot from high in the rafters: the arena a vast dark bowl, the player tiny at mid-court with his palms up, and six white spotlight beams stabbing down from the roof and converging on him, the only light in the building.

Behind him the rim and its net are enormous, filling the top of the frame, the net still swinging, and six balls lie scattered on the hardwood under it where they fell, each one glowing faintly. Smoke along the floor.

moments.title: The Flu Game
moments.look: Feverish: sickly green in the shadows, sweat and haze, the two red jerseys the only saturated colour.
moments.prompt: Two teammates in red jerseys walk off the floor toward the viewer. The one on the right is slumped and spent, head hanging, knees buckling. The one on the left holds him up with an arm wrapped around his shoulders, taking his weight. The arena behind them is a dark blur, the floor runs back into fog, and a green sickly light bleeds through the haze. Faces down, in shadow.

moments.title: The Block
moments.look: Monumental low angle, the backboard glass huge, a sea of yellow light behind, cracks catching the light.
moments.prompt: From behind the baseline, below the rim. A guard in a white jersey is in the air at the end of a layup, the ball just leaving his hand toward the glass. A forward in a black jersey has flown in from the left at full stretch and pins the ball flat against the backboard with his right hand, inches from the rim, cracks spreading from the ball across the glass. Behind the glass the whole arena is a solid field of yellow light. Faces hidden by arms and angle.

moments.title: The Lob
moments.look: Deep purple dark, gold light, smoke rising, scale like a cathedral.
moments.prompt: A huge centre in a gold jersey is above the rim with both hands on the ball, catching an alley-oop, about to dunk. Below and far to the right, outside the arc, a guard in gold stands with his right arm still pointed up at the rim, and the pass's path is a thin gold arc across the dark between them. Under the basket a defender in black is beaten, arms down, turning to watch. Purple void, the key drawn in gold light on the floor.

moments.title: The Skyhook
moments.look: One warm spotlight, figures like statues, gold on black.
moments.prompt: From the baseline, slightly below. A seven-foot centre in a gold jersey, wearing goggles, is turned sideways to the basket releasing a hook shot: left arm raised across his body as a shield, right arm fully straight above his head, the ball leaving his fingertips at the very top of the frame. A defender in green stands chest to chest with him, both arms up, a full head short. The rim at the top right, the ball's arc a thin gold line toward it. Black void. Faces in shadow under the light.

moments.title: The Dream Shake
moments.look: Motion and light trails, one sharp figure, ghosts fading, red on black.
moments.prompt: On the low block with his back to the rim at the top of the frame, a centre in a red jersey is caught sharp at the end of a spin, pivoting toward the baseline with the ball at his hip and his head turned over his shoulder toward the rim. Three fading ghosts of him trail off to the right, the fake he just sold the other way. Beside him the defender in white is a smear of motion leaning hard the wrong way, feet crossed, hand grabbing at nothing. Black void, the key a pale wedge of floor.

moments.title: The Shot
moments.look: Hang time: a cold spotlight, red on near-black, everything still but the falling defender.
moments.prompt: From the side at chest height. A shooter in a red jersey hangs in the air at the free-throw line at the top of his jump, knees tucked, the ball at the top of a double-clutch release above his head. A defender in a white jersey with orange trim has already sailed past him to the left, arm up, too early, falling. The free-throw line and the key glow under them; the rim at the top right; a clock in the dark reads 0:03. Faces turned away.

moments.title: From the Line
moments.look: A black arena pricked with a thousand camera flashes, the figure lit from below, red and gold.
moments.prompt: Strict side profile. A player in a red jersey in full flight, body stretched flat and horizontal, legs split front and back, the ball held high in his leading hand with the arm straight, soaring from the free-throw line toward a rim at the right edge of the frame. The free-throw line glows below where he took off; the painted key is the only floor. The darkness around him is full of tiny camera flashes like stars.

moments.title: The Stepover
moments.look: One hard spotlight, long shadows, gold floor, black beyond.
moments.prompt: Floor level, looking along the hardwood. A small guard in a white jersey with a sleeve on one arm steps over a defender who lies flat on his back on the floor in a gold jersey, the standing figure towering out of the top of the frame and looking down at him. Long hard shadows run toward the viewer across a glowing gold floor; everything beyond is black. Faces in shadow.

moments.title: The Dunk of Death
moments.look: Pale blue arena light, dust in the air, navy and white, the leap at impossible height.
moments.prompt: From the side. A guard in a dark navy jersey is at the top of a leap, legs spread wide, clearing the head of a seven-foot defender in a white jersey who stands under him and ducks, the ball slammed down one-handed at the rim at the top of the frame. The court below is a pale blue slab in a black void. Faces hidden by the angle.
